title: Practice Test · October 2026

parts.title: Section 1, Module 1: Reading and Writing
parts.directions_html:
This section tests reading and writing skills. Each question comes with one or more short texts, which may include a table or a graph.

Read each text and question carefully, then choose the one best answer based on the text or texts.

Every question in this section is multiple-choice with four answer choices (A–D). Each question has one best answer.

parts.title: Section 2, Module 1: Math
parts.directions_html:
This section tests math skills. Some questions are multiple-choice with four answer choices (A–D): choose the one best answer. For the other questions you type your own answer in a box (student-produced response); the rules for entering an answer are shown next to each of those questions.

You may use the built-in calculator on any question (Calculator, top right). Common formulas are on the Reference sheet (top right).

Unless a question says otherwise:

  • All variables and expressions stand for real numbers.
  • Figures are drawn to scale and lie in a plane.
  • The domain of a function \(f\) is every real number \(x\) for which \(f(x)\) is a real number.
